description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - talk replay: during a talk with a landlord, client or technician, subtitles arrive tagged by the side you mark (other party / yourself) and the direction you were facing; after the talk, replay lists only three kinds of sentences - promises, numbers, deadlines - filterable by kind, then a summary listing the other party's promises one by one. Session memory only, wiped on close.
name: talk-replay
